Both the test suite and the ground-truth verifier pass.

**Bug:** in `src/pricing.js`, `orderTotal` computed tax on the original amount instead of the discounted amount, even though its comment said tax should apply after the discount.

**Fix:** one line — tax now applies to `discounted` instead of `cents` (src/pricing.js:41).

All 625 cases pass and `verify.js` confirms it.
